Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

MMLU-Pro: A More Robust and Challenging Multi-Task Language Understanding Benchmark · documents: The v1 paper describes filtering out MMLU questions answered correctly by more than four of eight specified models, then using GPT-4-Turbo to extract answers and generate additional distractors, with manual checking of extracted answers.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

MMLU-Pro: A More Robust and Challenging Multi-Task Language Understanding Benchmark · documents: The v1 paper states that its multiple-choice format may fail to capture comprehension depth and creative responses as effectively as open-ended answers, and that its assessment is language-only rather than multimodal.
